name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.ExteriorDualPresheafPairing.semilinear_pairing_ext
statement:
theorem semilinear_pairing_ext {R S E F E' F' : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F]
    [AddCommGroup E'] [Module S E'] [AddCommGroup F'] [Module S F']
    (ρ : R →+* S) (f : E → E') (g : F → F')
    (hf_add : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (hf_smul : ∀ (r : R) x, f (r • x) = ρ r • f x)
    (hg_add : ∀ x y, g (x + y) = g x + g y) (hg_smul : ∀ (r : R) x, g (r • x) = ρ r • g x)
    (P : E →ₗ[R] F →ₗ[R] R) (Q : E' →ₗ[S] F' →ₗ[S] S)
    {s : Set E} {t : Set F} (hs : Submodule.span R s = ⊤) (ht : Submodule.span R t = ⊤)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, Q (f a) (g b) = ρ (P a b)) (α : E) (z : F) :
    Q (f α) (g z) = ρ (P α z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsFrame.coord_map

    G.comp (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 M) (Localization M)) =
      F.comp (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 M) (Localization M))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleFrameChange.homogeneousLocalization_lift_eq
statement:
theorem homogeneousLocalization_lift_eq (M : Submonoid A) (f g : A →+* R) (a : Rˣ)
    (hscale : ∀ (d : ℕ) (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 d → g x = (a : R) ^ d * f x)
    (hf : ∀ x : M, IsUnit (f x)) (hg : ∀ x : M, IsUnit (g x)) :
    (IsLocalization.lift (S := Localization M) hg).comp
        (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 M) (Localization M)) =
      (IsLocalization.lift (S := Localization M) hf).comp
        (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 M) (Localization M))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleFrameChange.irrelevant_map_eq_of_unit_scale

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleFrameChange.irrelevant_map_eq_top_scale

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleFrameChange.toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections_unit_scale
statement:
theorem toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections_unit_scale (f g : A →+* Γ(T, ⊤))
    (a : Γ(T, ⊤)ˣ)
    (hscale : ∀ (d : ℕ) (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 d → g x = (a : Γ(T, ⊤)) ^ d * f x)
    {t : A} {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (ht : t ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    (T.isoOfEq (basicOpen_homogeneous_unit_scale 𝒜 f g a hscale ht).symm).hom ≫
        Proj.toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections 𝒜 g rfl hd ht =
      Proj.toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections 𝒜 f rfl hd ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleRestriction.fromOfGlobalSections_homOfLE
statement:
theorem fromOfGlobalSections_homOfLE (T : Scheme.{u}) (U V : T.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V)
    (f : A →+* Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤))
    (hf : (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).toIdeal.map f = ⊤) :
    T.homOfLE hUV ≫ Proj.fromOfGlobalSections 𝒜 f hf =
      Proj.fromOfGlobalSections 𝒜 ((T.homOfLE hUV).appTop.hom.comp f)
        (irrelevant_map_eq_top_comp 𝒜 f (T.homOfLE hUV).appTop.hom hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleRestriction.fromOfGlobalSections_naturality
statement:
theorem fromOfGlobalSections_naturality (h : S ⟶ T) (f : A →+* Γ(T, ⊤))

    h ≫ Proj.fromOfGlobalSections 𝒜 f hf =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleRestriction.irrelevant_map_eq_top_comp
statement:
theorem irrelevant_map_eq_top_comp {R : Type w} {B : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.ProjectiveTupleRestriction.toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections_naturality
statement:
theorem toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections_naturality (h : S ⟶ T) (f : A →+* Γ(T, ⊤))
    {t : A} {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (ht : t ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    h.resLE (T.basicOpen (f t)) (S.basicOpen ((h.appTop.hom.comp f) t))

      Proj.toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections 𝒜 (h.appTop.hom.comp f) rfl hd ht

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.coord_homogeneousSection
statement:
theorem coord_homogeneousSection (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.divideSection_multiplySection

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.divideSection_restrict
statement:
theorem divideSection_restrict (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

statement:
theorem divideSection_val (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.exists_divideValue
statement:
theorem exists_divideValue (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (hU : ∀ x : U, g ∉ x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal)
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens) (s : ((sheaf 𝒜 (d : ℤ)).restrict U.ι).val.obj (op V)) :
    (homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso 𝒜 d g hg U hU).hom.val.app (op V) s =

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app_restrictAppIso_inv
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app_restrictAppIso_inv (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

    (homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso 𝒜 d g hg U hU).hom.app V

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app_top_homogeneousSection
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app_top_homogeneousSection (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (hU : ∀ x : U, g ∉ x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal)
    (a : A) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d) {V' : (Proj 𝒜).Opens}
    (hV' : ∀ x : V', g ∉ x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal) (hUV : U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ V') :
    (homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso 𝒜 d g hg U hU).hom.app ⊤
        (((sheaf 𝒜 (d : ℤ)).restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).inv
          ((sheaf 𝒜 (d : ℤ)).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
            (homogeneousSection 𝒜 d a ha ⊤))) =
      (U.ι.appIso ⊤).hom ((Proj 𝒜).presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op
        (divideSection 𝒜 d g hg hV' (homogeneousSection 𝒜 d a ha V')))

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app_top_of_eq
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_app_top_of_eq (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (hU : ∀ x : U, g ∉ x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal)
    (a : A) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d) {V' : (Proj 𝒜).Opens}
    (hV' : ∀ x : V', g ∉ x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal) (hUV : U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ V')
    {P : (Proj 𝒜).Modules} (hP : sheaf 𝒜 (d : ℤ) = P)
    (e : P.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf))
    (he : e = hP ▸ homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso 𝒜 d g hg U hU)
    (x : Γ(P.restrict U.ι, ⊤))
    (hx : x = (P.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).inv
      (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
        (hP ▸ homogeneousSection 𝒜 d a ha ⊤)))
    (r : Γ(Proj 𝒜, V')) (hr : divideSection 𝒜 d g hg hV' (homogeneousSection 𝒜 d a ha V') = r) :
    e.hom.app ⊤ x = (U.ι.appIso ⊤).hom ((Proj 𝒜).presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op r)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_section
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_section (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_val
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_hom_val (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (hU : ∀ x : U, g ∉ x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal)

      ((homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso 𝒜 d g hg U hU).hom.val.app (op V) s)).1 x).val =

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_inv_app

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_inv_val
statement:
theorem homogeneousCoordinateFrameIso_inv_val (d : ℕ) (g : A) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 d)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.ProjTwisting.homogeneousFrameSectionEquiv_one

statement:

statement:
theorem weightedProjCoordinateFrameIso_hom_val (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b)

name: MiyaokaMori.WeightedJets.weightedProjCoordinateFrameIso_section
statement:

theorem lemmaA {D V : C} {c : 𝟙_ C ⟶ D ⊗ V} {ev : D ⊗ V ⟶ 𝟙_ C} (h : Z2 c ev) (σ : 𝟙_ C ⟶ V) :
    c ≫ ((ρ_ D).inv ≫ D ◁ σ ≫ ev) ▷ V ≫ (λ_ V).hom = σ

name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Zigzag.lemmaB
statement:
theorem lemmaB {D V : C} {c : 𝟙_ C ⟶ D ⊗ V} {ev : D ⊗ V ⟶ 𝟙_ C} (h : Z1 c ev) (ψ : D ⟶ 𝟙_ C) :
    (ρ_ D).inv ≫ D ◁ (c ≫ ψ ▷ V ≫ (λ_ V).hom) ≫ ev = ψ

name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Zigzag.whiskerLeft_rightUnitor_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_rightUnitor_eq {D : C} (ψ : D ⟶ 𝟙_ C) :
    D ◁ ψ ≫ (ρ_ D).hom = (β_ D D).hom ≫ ψ ▷ D ≫ (λ_ D).hom

name: CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.Zigzag.whiskerLeft_whiskerRight_leftUnitor_comp
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_whiskerRight_leftUnitor_comp {D V : C} (ψ : D ⟶ 𝟙_ C) (ev : D ⊗ V ⟶ 𝟙_ C) :
    D ◁ (ψ ▷ V) ≫ D ◁ (λ_ V).hom ≫ ev =
      (α_ D D V).inv ≫ (β_ D D).hom ▷ V ≫ (α_ D D V).hom ≫ D ◁ ev ≫ (ρ_ D).hom ≫ ψ

theorem map_comp (φ : R →+* R') (ψ : A →+* A') (χ : B →+* B')
    (hψ : ∀ r : R, ψ (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R' A' (φ r))
    (hχ : ∀ r : R, χ (algebraMap R B r) = algebraMap R' B' (φ r))
    (φ' : R' →+* R'') (ψ' : A' →+* A'') (χ' : B' →+* B'')
    (hψ' : ∀ r : R', ψ' (algebraMap R' A' r) = algebraMap R'' A'' (φ' r))
    (hχ' : ∀ r : R', χ' (algebraMap R' B' r) = algebraMap R'' B'' (φ' r))
    (hψ'' : ∀ r : R, (ψ'.comp ψ) (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R'' A'' ((φ'.comp φ) r))
    (hχ'' : ∀ r : R, (χ'.comp χ) (algebraMap R B r) = algebraMap R'' B'' ((φ'.comp φ) r)) :
    (map φ' ψ' χ' hψ' hχ').comp (map φ ψ χ hψ hχ) =
      map (φ'.comp φ) (ψ'.comp ψ) (χ'.comp χ) hψ'' hχ''

    (P : Fin (N + 1) → Polynomial K)
    (hdeg : ∀ ℓ, (P ℓ).natDegree ≤ r₀) (hne : ∃ ℓ, P ℓ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m dD : ℕ) (Q : Fin (N + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)
      (D : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K),
      m + dD = r₀ ∧ m ≤ r₀ ∧
      (∀ ℓ, (Q ℓ).IsHomogeneous m) ∧ D.IsHomogeneous dD ∧ D ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ x : Fin 2 → K, x ≠ 0 → ∃ ℓ, MvPolynomial.eval x (Q ℓ) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ ℓ, (P ℓ).homogenize r₀ = D * Q ℓ)
